summary: Calibrates the in-sample and two-stage class-choosing nulls across B1749 (N <= 12) and B1755 (N in {13,14,15,20}) for P-381 and P-384, showing that on B1755 all four class-choosing nulls (in-sample prime divisibility 0.3575% at p=5 / 0.1325% at p=3, exact order 0.1413%, slope alpha 0.4488%, and two-stage B1749->B1755 prime selection 0.1563%) exceed 0.1%, and that min chi2_six along alpha=2/5 has Pearson correlation r = 0.8953 between B1749 and B1755. Completes the P-386 non-authoring cryptographic, AST, and symbolic SymPy audit of the sealed P210 package (39ce620a8) and the six October 24-26 analytical reduction notes (65dd3c112..a506b1b15) on origin/audit/physical-bridge-2026-09-05.
